title: IOC List Distributor
description: Listens to an OpenCTI live stream, keeps the current IP, domain, URL and hash indicators in a local SQLite database (added on create and update, removed on revoke and delete) and publishes them as plain-text lists (one entry per line) over HTTP and/or HTTPS, for any client to pull. Two services share one image: connector (stream to database) and feed-distributor (database to files to HTTP).
short_description: Turns an OpenCTI live stream into plain-text IP, domain, URL and hash feeds.
